## Data Product Overview
This report visualises the total number of prescription items dispensed by each practice, broken down by contractor and region. It includes metrics such as item counts, prescribing trends, and comparative analysis across practices, providing a clear view of overall dispensing activity. The report is accessible via ePACT2 for authorised users and Catalyst for aggregated insights, ensuring transparency and supporting operational planning.

Purpose:
The report helps NHS England, commissioners, and contractors monitor prescribing volumes at practice level, identify high-activity areas, and support resource allocation. It is a key tool for understanding demand patterns and ensuring efficient service delivery.

How to Use:
Users can filter by practice, contractor, or region to review item volumes, compare trends, and benchmark performance. Commissioners use it for capacity planning, audit, and prescribing optimisation, while practices and contractors can track their own activity for quality improvement. Public users can view aggregated data to understand prescribing activity across regions.
